challenge: Nissan Oman needed a social identity spanning a broad vehicle range and a place with distinctive heritage, landscapes and different driving motivations. A consistent brand platform had to remain relevant to local audiences without making every vehicle post feel interchangeable.
insight: Oman is not a backdrop; it can be the editorial language that connects a brand to life. Different vehicle personalities can share a recognizable storytelling system while retaining model-specific use cases.
idea: “Into the Horizon” positions Nissan Oman as a curated lifestyle magazine: Living Heritage for Patrol, design-led encounters for Nissan Z, and everyday journeys for the wider line-up. The proposal connects product storytelling to local craft, terrain, places and people.
execution: 90-day editorial strategy and content mix, including model narratives and creator partnerships
Proposed mix of 52 feed posts and 14 Reels in the pitch scope — planned deliverables, not published output
Patrol hero film and Nissan Z creative episodes proposed; visual storyboards are included, actual final MP4 files not recovered
Audience segments, content pillars, test-drive journeys, platform roles and measurement framework
role: Regional creative direction, concept and narrative development; collaborative agency pitch.
source: Nissan Horizon Pitch and Nissan Oman Horizon Presentation (internal proposal)
subtitle: 90-day automotive content ecosystem
